ask.label: Ask for a new link
ask.checkingBody: Many requests came from your network: we check this one before passing it on. It takes a few seconds.
ask.answer: We passed this on to {sender}, who sent you this link. If the link was theirs, they will write to the address it was sent to.
ask.answerAnonymous: We passed this on to the person who sent you this link. If the link was theirs, they will write to the address it was sent to.
ask.onFile: A new link only ever goes to the address this one was sent to, never to one typed here.
ask.noteHint: It goes with your request to the person who sent you this link.
ask.wait: You asked several times already. You can ask again at {time}.
ask.failed: Your request did not reach us. Check the connection and ask again.

drafts.until: Finish later from the same link until {day}. Nothing is kept on this device.
drafts.laterTitle: Saved — you can close this page
drafts.laterBody: Open the same link again before {day} to finish where you left off.
drafts.restored: We kept what you filled in on {day} at {time}
drafts.restoredBody: Go on where you left off, or start again.
drafts.deadTitle: This link no longer keeps your draft
drafts.deadBody: It was used, expired or withdrawn meanwhile. What you typed is still on this page until you close it.

held.empty: Fill in something first: there is nothing to keep yet.
held.tooBig: This form is too large to keep as a draft: send it as it is, or shorten your notes.
held.dead: This link no longer keeps drafts.
